methodology.early_season: Weeks 1-2: 35% all-play, 35% scoring, 20% record, 10% neutral floor. The live week is marked provisional until ESPN standings close.
methodology.standard: Week 3 onward: 30% all-play, 25% scoring, 20% latest-three form, 15% record, 10% scoring floor.
methodology.editor: The Google Sheet can add a bounded -5 to +5 editor adjustment and commentary. The model score always remains visible beside the published score.
